q: Several capacitors can be ____ together to be used in a variety of applications.
e: Several capacitors can be connected together to be used in a variety of applications. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field. Be ____ together to be used in a variety of applications. connected.

q: There are two types of combination namely; parallel and ____.
e: There are two types of combination namely; parallel and series. In parallel, the same voltage sits across each branch and the currents add. In series, the same current runs through each part and the voltages add.

q: In a parallel combination, all the capacitors have the same potential ____.
e: In a parallel combination, all the capacitors have the same potential difference. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field. In parallel, the same voltage sits across each branch and the currents add.

q: When capacitors are connected in parallel, they carry ____ amounts of charges.
e: When capacitors are connected in parallel, they carry different amounts of charges. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field. In parallel, the same voltage sits across each branch and the currents add.

q: If Q is the total charge on three capacitors in parallel, then Q = ____.
e: If Q is the total charge on three capacitors in parallel, then Q = Q1 + Q2 + Q3. In parallel, the same voltage sits across each branch and the currents add. Charge is conserved; it is what a current carries and what a capacitor stores on its plates.

q: We can replace the three capacitors in parallel with a ____ capacitor provided it has the same total charge Q.
e: We can replace the three capacitors in parallel with a single capacitor provided it has the same total charge Q. Charge is conserved; it is what a current carries and what a capacitor stores on its plates. Parallel capacitors share voltage, charges add, and equivalent C is the sum.

q: The equivalent capacitance of capacitors connected in parallel is the ____ of the individual capacitances.
e: The equivalent capacitance of capacitors connected in parallel is the sum of the individual capacitances. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field. In parallel, the same voltage sits across each branch and the currents add.

q: The equivalent capacitance C of the parallel combination of n identical capacitors, each of capacitance $C_1$, is C = ____.
e: The equivalent capacitance C of the parallel combination of n identical capacitors, each of capacitance C1, is C = n C1. In parallel, the same voltage sits across each branch and the currents add. Parallel capacitors share voltage, charges add, and equivalent C is the sum.

q: In a series combination, the negatively charged plate of one capacitor is connected to the ____ charged plate of the other.
e: In a series combination, the negatively charged plate of one capacitor is connected to the positively charged plate of the other. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field. In series, the same current runs through each part and the voltages add.

q: Since the capacitors are connected in series each capacitor has the same ____.
e: Since the capacitors are connected in series each capacitor has the same charge. In series, the same current runs through each part and the voltages add. Charge is conserved; it is what a current carries and what a capacitor stores on its plates.

q: When capacitors are connected in series, they have ____ potential differences.
e: When capacitors are connected in series, they have different potential differences. Potential difference is the electrical push between two points; no push, no current. In series, the same current runs through each part and the voltages add.

q: Suppose that V is the ____ potential difference of the series capacitor combination.
e: Suppose that V is the total potential difference of the series capacitor combination. Series capacitors share charge, voltages add, and equivalent C is smaller than the smallest. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: We can replace the three capacitors in series with an ____ capacitor.
e: We can replace the three capacitors in series with an equivalent capacitor. Series capacitors share charge, voltages add, and equivalent C is smaller than the smallest. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field.

q: When connected in series, the ____ of the equivalent capacitance is the sum of the reciprocals of their individual capacitances.
e: When connected in series, the reciprocal of the equivalent capacitance is the sum of the reciprocals of their individual capacitances. In series, the same current runs through each part and the voltages add. Capacitance is the sum of the reciprocals of their individual capacitances. reciprocal.

q: The equivalent capacitance $C_s$ of the series combination of n identical capacitors, each of capacitance C, is $C_s = $ ____.
e: The equivalent capacitance Cs of the series combination of n identical capacitors, each of capacitance C, is Cs = C/n. Two conductors and a dielectric hold opposite charge, so energy sits in the electric field. In series, the same current runs through each part and the voltages add.
